output.summary: The 98.1% figure is measured against a promised date that dispatchers can overwrite. Revisions jumped 5x exactly when the bonus took effect at each center (Mar for Northgate and Riverside, Jul for Pell Junction). The mix shifted to Operational-Capacity reasons, later entry and less customer notification. Customer-requested revisions stayed flat. Brightwell's receiving logs show 81% on time against 87% a year earlier, and lateness complaints rose 35%. RouteWise did not drive the metric: Northgate jumped before its go-live. The driver shortage is plausible but unproven. Suspend the claim and recompute against original dates. Re-base the incentive. Do not raise the bonus, run the campaign or fund hiring yet.
